e.title: aero-audit：用注入攻击测自己的召回率，把测出来的精度权重写进风险分，并把两个测不到的缺口直接标为已知缺口
e.title_en: aero-audit: measuring its own recall with injected attacks, feeding the measured precision into the risk score as weights, and labelling the two scenarios it cannot catch as known gaps
e.title_hk: aero-audit：用注入攻擊測自己的召回率，把測出來的精度權重寫進風險分，並把兩個測不到的缺口直接標為已知缺口
e.summary: 一个端到端的航空监视审计系统：从公开 ADS-B 源跟踪真实飞机，把每个位置报文对照物理、完整性与安全规则以及一个异常模型来检查，用注入攻击测自己的检测准确率并把测出的精度作为权重写进风险评分，输出带 SHA-256 清单与溯源块的可核验报告；它把审计日志做成哈希链使任何增删改序都能被指认，并明确报告有两个攻击情景是它测不到的已知缺口
e.summary_hk: 一個端到端的航空監視審計系統：從公開 ADS-B 源跟蹤真實飛機，把每個位置報文對照物理、完整性與安全規則以及一個異常模型來檢查，用注入攻擊測自己的檢測準確率並把測出的精度作為權重寫進風險評分，輸出帶 SHA-256 清單與溯源塊的可核驗報告；它把審計日誌做成哈希鏈使任何增刪改序都能被指認，並明確報告有兩個攻擊情景是它測不到的已知缺口
e.summary_en: An end-to-end aviation surveillance auditing system: it follows real aircraft from public ADS-B feeds, checks every position report against physics, integrity and safety rules plus an anomaly model, measures its own detection accuracy with injected attacks and feeds the measured precision into the risk score as weights, and emits verifiable reports with SHA-256 manifests and provenance blocks; its audit log is a hash chain so any edited, deleted or reordered line can be named, and it explicitly reports that two attack scenarios are known gaps it cannot catch
e.body:
**aero-audit** 是一个**端到端的航空监视审计系统**（仓库 `monykiss/aero-audit`），**实测 MIT 许可（`LICENSE` 于 main 分支实测 200）、★0、fork 0、主语言 Python（自述要求 3.12+）、仓库体量 3,985 KB、创建与最后推送均为 2026-09-10**（**均 GitHub API 实测值，在解冻窗口内**）；**实测 topics 10 项**：**`ads-b`、`anomaly-detection`、`aviation`、`computer-vision`、`machine-learning`、`portfolio`、`python`、`risk-management`、`security`、`surveillance`**；**README 实测 17,369 字节**，**自述版本 0.4.0**；**已实测存在的关键文件**：**`LICENSE`、`CHANGELOG.md`、`docs/DEMO.md`**。**⚠️ 本条目需在开头写清一处范围问题**：**这是航空**监视安全**（ADS-B 欺骗与异常检测）工具，**不是航空保险**；**它**不填补本站「航空险」这一真空白**（**详见下方标注 ①**）。本条目属于本轮主题**「分开『我看到了什么』与『我因此断定什么』」**中的**第四种，也是唯一把「我自己测得准不准」**直接写进了评分公式**的一种**。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测**）：**定位逐字为**：**「**Aviation surveillance auditing, end to end.** aero-audit follows real aircraft from public ADS-B feeds, checks every position report **against physics, integrity and safety rules plus an anomaly model**, **measures its own detection accuracy with injected attacks**, **scores risk from the evidence**, and shows all of it in a terminal-style local app whose **every action and report is tamper-evident**.」**；**并逐字声明**：**「It runs **offline in one command**, on any machine, and **never transmits anything**.」**。

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「用注入攻击测自己、再把测出的精度当权重写进评分」是本条目最重要的一点，也是本会话见到**把自测结果回灌进生产判断**最彻底的一例**——**逐字为**：**「**Measures itself**: `aero evaluate` perturbs real aircraft with **eight attack scenarios** and reports **recall, time-to-detect and per-rule precision**. **Those numbers weight the risk score and the risk register; two scenarios are known gaps and are reported as such.**」**——**即「`aero evaluate` 用八个攻击情景扰动真实飞机，报告**召回率、发现时延与逐规则精度**。**这些数字会作为权重进入风险评分与风险清单；其中两个情景是已知缺口，并被如实报告为缺口。」**⭐⭐⭐ **三点值得单独记**：**① 精度不是用来写论文的，而是**评分公式的输入****（**其包结构亦逐字印证**：`audit/` 下含 **`policy (precision-weighted score)`**）；**② 有两个情景**测不到**，而它**不把这两项从指标里删掉或含糊过去**，**而是**明确列为已知缺口****；**③ 这一点对本站连续多轮的「把边界写在明面上」是**强度最高的形态之一**——**前面几轮多为**文字声明**，而这里是把**测不到的项进了指标报告本身****（**可与第 331 轮 [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]] 的「占位符待对账」、第 332 轮 [[insurance-fraud-risk-scoring]] 的「PR-AUC 1.00 是 bug 报告」并读**；**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其八个情景覆盖充分或那两个缺口已被量化**——**本次未运行 `aero evaluate`**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「Two things a reviewer can check rather than take on faith」一节逐字，是本条目在可核验性上最值得记的一处**——**其小标题逐字为**：**「**Trustworthy by construction** — Two things a reviewer can check rather than take on faith.」**⭐⭐ **「让复核者**可以自己查**而不是**凭信任接受**」这一措辞本身，**正是本轮主题的直接表述****。**其第一条「Auditable」逐字为**：**「The app’s audit log is **a hash chain: every entry carries the SHA-256 of the one before it and of itself**, so **an edited, deleted or reordered line is named by `aero log verify`** and by the **CHAIN VERIFIED** badge on the Audit log page. **Every report ships with a provenance block (tool version, git commit, input recording and its hash, model hash and registry status, evaluation hash, threshold overrides)** and a manifest that `aero log verify-report` … re-hash. **Injected demo traffic is flagged in every finding.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三点值得单独记**：**① 哈希链不只是防篡改，而是**能指认具体哪一行被增删改序**（`aero log verify`）**；**② 每份报告带**七项溯源块**（工具版本、git commit、输入录制及其哈希、模型哈希与登记状态、评测哈希、阈值覆盖）；**③ **注入的演示流量在每一条发现里都被标记****——**即**演示数据与真实数据在输出层面可区分**（**可与第 330 轮 [[catrisk-sim]] 的「synthetic and deliberately simplified」、第 332 轮 [[guidewire-claim-intelligence]] 的「metrics are on synthetic data」并读——**三位作者都在**不让合成数据冒充真实结果****）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **「Secure by default」一节逐字，是本会话见到**对本地服务安全写得最具体**的一段**——**逐字给出理由与对策**：**「A server on 127.0.0.1 is reachable from every web page you have open, so the app **validates the `Host` header against DNS rebinding**, requires a **per-process token on every POST** (which **forces the CORS preflight the server never grants**), checks `Origin` and `Sec-Fetch-Site`, serves a **strict Content-Security-Policy with no inline script**, **confines every path parameter to the project’s data directories**, accepts only `http(s)` webhooks, and **loads a model only when its SHA-256 matches the registry that `aero train` wrote**. **Binding beyond loopback requires a token on every API call.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **其中最值得记住的是**「localhost 服务器对你打开的每一个网页都是可达的」这一前提****——**它把**DNS 重绑定**、**CSRF 预检**与**路径穿越**三类针对本地开发服务的攻击写得具体而克制**；**而对精算建模的同学，**「模型只有在 SHA-256 与训练时写入的登记表一致时才被加载」**是一条可直接借用的**模型完整性门****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其防护完整或无遗漏**——**本次未做任何安全评估**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **供应链与 CI 的交代逐字且具体**：**「Dependencies install with **`--require-hashes`** from a universal lock; CI runs **ruff, pytest, docs-drift, `pip-audit`, gitleaks over the full history, CodeQL** and a container smoke test, **with every action pinned to a commit SHA**.」**⭐⭐ **其中两点少见**：**① `--require-hashes` 从通用锁文件安装**（**依赖内容锁定而不只是版本锁定**）；**② CI 含 **`docs-drift`**——即**检查文档是否已与实现脱节****（**可与第 329 轮 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的 pre-commit 自动重生成工作流图并读——**两者都在**防止文档与实现漂移****）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **规则与模型的分工逐字，是本轮主题在其内部架构上的落点**——**逐字为**：**「Audits every fix with **explainable rules**: impossible jumps, speed and altitude physics, **integrity below 14 CFR 91.227 minimums**, replayed fixes, ghosts, emergency and hijack codes **with confirmation tiers**, holding, level busts, coverage gaps, stream floods and collapses, cross-feed disagreement, watchlists. **Every finding maps to a control reference and a response playbook.**」**，**而机器学习逐字为**：**「Learns the airspace’s normal envelope with **per-regime IsolationForests over twelve kinematic features, percentile-calibrated, with two-fix persistence before a finding is raised**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **两点值得单独记**：**① 「每一条发现都映射到一个控制引用与一份响应手册」**——**即「发现了什么」与「因此该做什么」被显式连起来**（**这正是本轮主题**）；**② 「需连续两次报点（two-fix persistence）才升级为发现」**是一条**抑制误报的去抖规则****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该规则能消除误报**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **其流水线与包结构逐字，含一处关键的架构命名**——**流水线逐字为**：**live feeds（adsb.lol、OpenSky、NOAA METAR、FAA NAS status）→ normalize（StateVector）→ **JSONL recording（replayable）** → TrackStore（kinematics）→ **rules + ML + watchlist** → findings（SEC／OPS／SAF、ML-001 流检查）→ **risk score → trust ledger → alerts**」**；**并有**「two feeds → cross-feed corroboration (dead-reckoned) → SEC-015」**与**「imagery → YOLO (tiled) → apron zone occupancy → OPS-VIS findings」**两条旁路**；**其包结构逐字含**：**`ingest/`（adsblol、opensky、metar、faa_status、replay、http curl fallback）、`stream/`（async poller ＋ JSONL recorder）、**`provenance.py`**、`features/`（TrackStore）、`audit/`（rules、findings、**policy（precision-weighted score）**、engine、reports）、`ml/`（IsolationForest model、trainer、**registry（checksum gate）**、evaluation harness）、`security/`**⭐⭐ **「risk score → **trust ledger**」这一环值得注意**：**评分之后还有一个**信任台账****（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**该台账的设计**——**本次未读源码**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **报告与风险登记的统计方法逐字，且比同类项目更讲究**——**逐字为**：**「Reports: **JSON, Markdown, self-contained HTML**, each with **provenance and a manifest of SHA-256 hashes**; **risk register with Wilson-bound likelihoods and residual risk**; **holding impact in fuel, CO2 and delay cost**.」**⭐⭐ **「Wilson 置信界」被用于**似然****——**即以**二项比例的置信区间**而非点估计来表达风险登记的频率**；**而把**等待（holding）的代价折算为燃油、CO₂ 与延误成本**，**是把运行影响货币化的一种具体做法**（**⚠️ 本词条**不主张**其折算系数或适用性**——**本次未读其实现**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **演示的设计逐字且含一处重要的数据出处与许可**：**「The demo replays a bundled sample of **real traffic (15 US hubs, 3,900 aircraft, adsb.lol, ODbL)** at 10x with a **scripted tour** that injects **eight attack scenarios** on a timeline. **The banner narrates each one and says what should fire.** Press **F2** for the map, **F6** for findings, **F8** for the hash-chained audit log, click **SND** to hear alerts.」**⭐⭐ **三点值得记**：**① 数据来自广告式公开源 adsb.lol 且**明确标注 ODbL 许可****（**对做数据来源合规的同学，这是**具名标注上游许可**的实例**）；**② 演示是一条**带解说的剧本化巡演**，**每个攻击情景都说明「应当触发什么」****——**即可与输出对照**；**③ 审计日志被做成了**可按键查看的界面元素**（F8）**，**而不只是后端文件**。**⑨ ⭐ **其余能力逐字且覆盖面明确**：**摄取**（adsb.lol 含完整性字段 **NIC／NACp／SIL**；OpenSky 全国框；NOAA METAR；FAA NAS status；**全部无需密钥**；一切录为**可回放的 JSONL**）；**生态理解**（**132 个北美机场、约 80 家运营人、约 180 种机型**、按场高判定飞行阶段、FAA 地面停止与延误程序）；**视觉**（机场停机坪影像上的**分块 YOLOv8 检测**与区域占用发现，**自述为可选项**）。**⑩ ⭐ **一键跑起来的方式逐字**：**`scripts/bootstrap.sh`（macOS／Linux：建 .venv、**经哈希校验的安装**、健康检查、打开演示）**、**Windows `bootstrap.ps1`**、**容器 `docker run --rm -p 127.0.0.1:8787:8787 …`**、**已装好则 `make demo`**；**界面为**终端风格（Bloomberg 式黑底琥珀色）、带助记命令行、功能键、行情条、可绘数千架飞机的画布地图、下拉筛选、可排序表格、随处可导出 CSV、后台任务、实时阈值调节与应用内文档****。**⑪ ⭐ **可与本站风险检测、审计与溯源条目并读**：[[claims-triage-risk-scoring-agent]]、[[claims-fraud-guardian]]、[[networkfraud]]、[[cybrisk]]、[[openriskscore]]、[[reproducible-actuarial-work]]、[[insurance-governance]]、[[claim-to-confidence]]、[[proof-protocol]]（**本批同轮：把「证据随主张同行」做成协议**）。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ **范围必须写清，且与本站的一处真空白有关**：**该仓库是**航空监视安全**（ADS-B 完整性与欺骗检测、流异常）工具，**不是航空保险**，**README 全文**未涉及承保、费率、条款或航空险市场**；**本站「航空险」这一**真空白**在连续多轮中**未被填补****（**第 327 轮曾确立其在 GitHub 上属结构性缺席**）；**本词条**明确不把本条计入航空险的覆盖，也不主张该空白被填补****——⭐ **唯一可记的联系是它使用**航空域**的公开数据与**风险／审计**方法**，**而这属于方法层面的类比，不是险种资料**；**②** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据、topics（10 项）、README（17,369 字节）全文的定位段、五分钟上手、能力清单、两节「Trustworthy by construction」、流水线与包结构、报告与风险登记说明、演示说明与运行方式**，**并以 raw 探测确认 `LICENSE`、`CHANGELOG.md`、`docs/DEMO.md` 均存在（HTTP 200）**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未运行 `scripts/bootstrap.sh` 或 `make demo`、未启动其本地应用、未运行 `aero evaluate`、未查看其演示或任何报告、未读 `aero_audit/` 下任何源码、未读 `SECURITY.md` 与 `docs/` 下任何文档、未打开 `docs/img/` 下任何截图****，因此**不能转述其规则实现、IsolationForest 特征与标定、风险评分公式、Wilson 界的计算方式、溯源块的实际字段值或任何指标数值**；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**其八个攻击情景下的**召回率、发现时延与逐规则精度**——**本次未运行 `aero evaluate`**；**本词条只记录其**自述方法**，**不主张**任何数值**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**「其中两个情景是已知缺口」具体指哪两个、以及缺口有多大**——**这是本条目最需要后续核实的一处**；**本词条**不主张**其已量化该缺口**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核实**「精度权重进入风险评分」在实现中确实成立**（**包结构中 `policy (precision-weighted score)` 为**其自述命名****）；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核实**审计日志确为哈希链、且 `aero log verify` 能指认被增删改序的行**；**本词条只核实在 README 中被如此描述**；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未做任何安全评估**——**其列出的 DNS 重绑定防护、每 POST 令牌、CSP、路径限制与模型哈希门**均为**其自述****；**本词条**不主张**其实际安全**；**⑦ ⭐⭐ **未核实**其演示所用 adsb.lol 数据的**ODbL 许可标注与再利用条件**是否符合该许可要求**（**本次未查阅 ODbL 原文，亦未核实 adsb.lol 的使用条款**）；**⑧ ⭐ **未核实**其「132 个北美机场、约 80 家运营人、约 180 种机型」等参考数据的来源与时效**；**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核实**其「never transmits anything」这一网络行为声明**——**本次未做任何流量观测**；**⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ **本词条**不主张**其与任何航空监管机构、机场或数据提供方存在认可、授权或背书关系**（**README 未作此类声明，本次亦未核实**）；**⑪ ⭐ ⚠️ **其 topic 含 `portfolio`****（**暗示其作者将其定位为作品集项目**）**；**本词条**不主张**其可用于任何真实的航空安全监视、运行决策或监管用途**——**航路安全与航空安保属高度受监管领域，其自述为本地、离线、不回传的工具**；**⑫ ⭐ ★0、fork 0**，**关注度极低**（**尽管其工程深度、安全自觉与文档量在本会话收集的项目中位居前列**）；**⑬ ⭐ 是否有中文材料本次未核实**（**README 实测为英文**）。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/monykiss/aero-audit` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（含许可、★数、语言、体量、创建／推送时间与 10 项 topics）；README 17,369 字节经 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 实测逐字核对；**`LICENSE`、`CHANGELOG.md`、`docs/DEMO.md` 经 raw 探测确认存在（HTTP 200）**；**未克隆、未运行、未启动、未做安全评估、未读源码与文档**。

**aero-audit** 是一個**端到端的航空監視審計系統**（倉庫 `monykiss/aero-audit`），**實測 MIT 許可（`LICENSE` 於 main 分支實測 200）、★0、fork 0、主語言 Python（自述要求 3.12+）、體量 3,985 KB、創建與最後推送均為 2026-09-10**（**在解凍窗口內**）；**實測 topics 10 項**：**`ads-b`、`anomaly-detection`、`aviation`、`computer-vision`、`machine-learning`、`portfolio`、`python`、`risk-management`、`security`、`surveillance`**；**README 實測 17,369 位元組**，**自述版本 0.4.0**；**已實測存在的關鍵檔案**：**`LICENSE`、`CHANGELOG.md`、`docs/DEMO.md`**。**⚠️ 本條目需在開頭寫清一處範圍問題**：**這是航空**監視安全**（ADS-B 欺騙與異常檢測）工具，**不是航空保險**；**它**不填補本站「航空險」這一真空白****。本條目屬本輪主題**「分開『我看到了什麼』與『我因此斷定什麼』」**中的**第四種，也是唯一把「我自己測得準不準」**直接寫進了評分公式**的一種**。

可核實資訊（**均 README 逐字實測**）：**定位逐字**：**「**Aviation surveillance auditing, end to end.** aero-audit follows real aircraft from public ADS-B feeds, checks every position report **against physics, integrity and safety rules plus an anomaly model**, **measures its own detection accuracy with injected attacks**, **scores risk from the evidence**, and shows all of it in a terminal-style local app whose **every action and report is tamper-evident**.」**；**並逐字聲明**「It runs **offline in one command**, on any machine, and **never transmits anything**.」**。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐⭐ **「用注入攻擊測自己、再把測出的精度當權重寫進評分」是最重要的一點****——**逐字「**Measures itself**: `aero evaluate` perturbs real aircraft with **eight attack scenarios** and reports **recall, time-to-detect and per-rule precision**. **Those numbers weight the risk score and the risk register; two scenarios are known gaps and are reported as such.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三點值得單獨記**：①**精度不是用來寫論文，而是**評分公式的輸入****（**其包結構逐字印證**：`audit/` 下含 **`policy (precision-weighted score)`**）；②**有兩個情景**測不到**，而它**不把這兩項從指標裡刪掉或含糊過去**，**而是**明確列為已知缺口****；③**對本站連續多輪的「把邊界寫在明面上」是**強度最高的形態之一**——**前幾輪多為**文字聲明**，這裡是把**測不到的項進了指標報告本身****（可與第 331 輪 [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]] 的「佔位符待對賬」、第 332 輪 [[insurance-fraud-risk-scoring]] 的「PR-AUC 1.00 是 bug 報告」並讀；**⚠️ 不主張**其八個情景覆蓋充分或那兩個缺口已被量化**）。**② ⭐⭐⭐ **「Trustworthy by construction — Two things a reviewer can check rather than take on faith.」一節逐字**⭐⭐ **「讓複核者**可以自己查**而不是**憑信任接受**」正是本輪主題的直接表述**。**其第一條逐字**：**「The app’s audit log is **a hash chain: every entry carries the SHA-256 of the one before it and of itself**, so **an edited, deleted or reordered line is named by `aero log verify`** and by the **CHAIN VERIFIED** badge… **Every report ships with a provenance block (tool version, git commit, input recording and its hash, model hash and registry status, evaluation hash, threshold overrides)** and a manifest that `aero log verify-report` … re-hash. **Injected demo traffic is flagged in every finding.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **三點值得單獨記**：①哈希鏈不只是防篡改，而是**能指認具體哪一行被增刪改序**；②每份報告帶**七項溯源塊**；③**注入的演示流量在每一條發現裡都被標記**——**演示資料與真實資料在輸出層面可區分**（可與第 330 輪 [[catrisk-sim]]、第 332 輪 [[guidewire-claim-intelligence]] 並讀——**三位作者都在不讓合成資料冒充真實結果**）。**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **「Secure by default」一節逐字，是本會話見到對本地服務安全寫得最具體的一段**——**逐字「A server on 127.0.0.1 is reachable from every web page you have open, so the app **validates the `Host` header against DNS rebinding**, requires a **per-process token on every POST** (which **forces the CORS preflight the server never grants**), checks `Origin` and `Sec-Fetch-Site`, serves a **strict Content-Security-Policy with no inline script**, **confines every path parameter to the project’s data directories**, accepts only `http(s)` webhooks, and **loads a model only when its SHA-256 matches the registry that `aero train` wrote**. **Binding beyond loopback requires a token on every API call.**」**⭐⭐⭐ **最值得記住的是**「localhost 伺服器對你打開的每一個網頁都是可達的」這一前提****；**而**「模型只有在 SHA-256 與訓練時寫入的登記表一致時才被載入」**是一條可直接借用的**模型完整性門****（**⚠️ 未做任何安全評估，不主張其防護完整**）。**④ ⭐⭐ **供應鏈與 CI 逐字**：**「Dependencies install with **`--require-hashes`** from a universal lock; CI runs **ruff, pytest, docs-drift, `pip-audit`, gitleaks over the full history, CodeQL** and a container smoke test, **with every action pinned to a commit SHA**.」**⭐⭐ **兩點少見**：①`--require-hashes` 從通用鎖檔安裝；②CI 含 **`docs-drift`**（**檢查文檔是否已與實現脫節**，可與第 329 輪 [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] 的 pre-commit 自動重生成工作流圖並讀）。**⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ **規則與模型的分工逐字**：**「Audits every fix with **explainable rules**: impossible jumps, speed and altitude physics, **integrity below 14 CFR 91.227 minimums**, replayed fixes, ghosts, emergency and hijack codes **with confirmation tiers**, holding, level busts, coverage gaps, stream floods and collapses, cross-feed disagreement, watchlists. **Every finding maps to a control reference and a response playbook.**」**，**機器學習逐字**「Learns the airspace’s normal envelope with **per-regime IsolationForests over twelve kinematic features, percentile-calibrated, with two-fix persistence before a finding is raised**.」**⭐⭐⭐ **兩點值得單獨記**：①**「每一條發現都映射到一個控制引用與一份響應手冊」**——**「發現了什麼」與「因此該做什麼」被顯式連起來**；②**「需連續兩次報點才升級為發現」是一條**抑制誤報的去抖規則****（**⚠️ 不主張**該規則能消除誤報**）。**⑥ ⭐⭐ **流水線與包結構逐字，含一處關鍵架構命名**：**流水線**「live feeds（adsb.lol、OpenSky、NOAA METAR、FAA NAS status）→ normalize（StateVector）→ **JSONL recording（replayable）** → TrackStore（kinematics）→ **rules + ML + watchlist** → findings（SEC／OPS／SAF、ML-001 流檢查）→ **risk score → trust ledger → alerts**」**，**另有兩條旁路**（**two feeds → cross-feed corroboration (dead-reckoned) → SEC-015**；**imagery → YOLO (tiled) → apron zone occupancy → OPS-VIS findings**）；**包結構逐字含** `ingest/`（adsblol、opensky、metar、faa_status、replay、http curl fallback）、`stream/`、**`provenance.py`**、`features/`、`audit/`（rules、findings、**policy（precision-weighted score）**、engine、reports）、`ml/`（IsolationForest model、trainer、**registry（checksum gate）**、evaluation harness）、`security/`**⭐⭐ **「risk score → **trust ledger**」這一環值得注意**（**⚠️ 未讀源碼，不主張該台賬設計**）。**⑦ ⭐⭐ **報告與風險登記的統計方法逐字**：**「Reports: **JSON, Markdown, self-contained HTML**, each with **provenance and a manifest of SHA-256 hashes**; **risk register with Wilson-bound likelihoods and residual risk**; **holding impact in fuel, CO2 and delay cost**.」**⭐⭐ **「Wilson 置信界」被用於**似然****——**以**二項比例的置信區間**而非點估計表達風險登記的頻率**；**而把**等待的代價折算為燃油、CO₂ 與延誤成本**，**是把運行影響貨幣化的一種具體做法**（**⚠️ 不主張**其折算係數或適用性**）。**⑧ ⭐⭐ **演示設計逐字且含一處重要的資料出處與許可**：**「The demo replays a bundled sample of **real traffic (15 US hubs, 3,900 aircraft, adsb.lol, ODbL)** at 10x with a **scripted tour** that injects **eight attack scenarios** on a timeline. **The banner narrates each one and says what should fire.** Press **F2** for the map, **F6** for findings, **F8** for the hash-chained audit log…」**⭐⭐ **三點值得記**：①資料來自 adsb.lol 且**明確標註 ODbL 許可**；②演示是一條**帶解說的劇本化巡演**，**每個攻擊情景都說明「應當觸發什麼」**；③審計日誌被做成**可按鍵查看的介面元素**（F8）。**⑨ ⭐ **其餘能力逐字**：**攝取**（adsb.lol 含完整性欄位 **NIC／NACp／SIL**；OpenSky 全國框；NOAA METAR；FAA NAS status；**全部無需密鑰**；一切錄為**可回放的 JSONL**）；**生態理解**（**132 個北美機場、約 80 家運營人、約 180 種機型**、按場高判定飛行階段、FAA 地面停止與延誤程序）；**視覺**（停機坪影像上的**分塊 YOLOv8 檢測**與區域佔用發現，**自述為可選項**）。**⑩ ⭐ **一鍵跑起來逐字**：`scripts/bootstrap.sh`（macOS／Linux：建 .venv、**經哈希校驗的安裝**、健康檢查、打開演示）、Windows `bootstrap.ps1`、容器 `docker run --rm -p 127.0.0.1:8787:8787 …`、已裝好則 `make demo`**；**介面為**終端風格（Bloomberg 式黑底琥珀色）、帶助記命令行、功能鍵、行情條、可繪數千架飛機的畫布地圖、下拉篩選、可排序表格、隨處可導出 CSV、後台任務、實時閾值調節與應用內文檔****。**⑪ ⭐ 可與 [[claims-triage-risk-scoring-agent]]、[[claims-fraud-guardian]]、[[networkfraud]]、[[cybrisk]]、[[openriskscore]]、[[reproducible-actuarial-work]]、[[insurance-governance]]、[[claim-to-confidence]]、[[proof-protocol]] 並讀**。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️ **範圍必須寫清，且與本站的一處真空白有關**：**該倉庫是**航空監視安全**（ADS-B 完整性與欺騙檢測、流異常）工具，**不是航空保險**，**README 全文**未涉及承保、費率、條款或航空險市場**；**本站「航空險」這一**真空白**在連續多輪中**未被填補****（**第 327 輪曾確立其在 GitHub 上屬結構性缺席**）；**本詞條**明確不把本條計入航空險的覆蓋，也不主張該空白被填補****——⭐ **唯一可記的聯繫是它使用**航空域**的公開資料與**風險／審計**方法**，**屬方法層面的類比，不是險種資料**；**②** 本次核實到**倉庫元數據、topics、README 全文的定位段、五分鐘上手、能力清單、兩節 Trustworthy by construction、流水線與包結構、報告與風險登記說明、演示說明與運行方式**，**並以 raw 探測確認 `LICENSE`、`CHANGELOG.md`、`docs/DEMO.md` 存在（HTTP 200）**，⭐⭐ **但**未克隆、未運行 `scripts/bootstrap.sh` 或 `make demo`、未啟動其本地應用、未運行 `aero evaluate`、未查看其演示或任何報告、未讀 `aero_audit/` 下任何源碼、未讀 `SECURITY.md` 與 `docs/` 下任何文檔、未打開 `docs/img/` 下任何截圖****；**② ⭐⭐⭐ **未核實**其八個攻擊情景下的**召回率、發現時延與逐規則精度**——**本次未運行 `aero evaluate`**，**只記錄其自述方法**；**③ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核實**「其中兩個情景是已知缺口」具體指哪兩個、以及缺口有多大**——**這是本條目最需要後續核實的一處**；**④ ⭐⭐⭐ **未核實**「精度權重進入風險評分」在實現中確實成立**（**包結構中 `policy (precision-weighted score)` 為其自述命名**）；**⑤ ⭐⭐ **未核實**審計日誌確為哈希鏈、且 `aero log verify` 能指認被增刪改序的行**；**⑥ ⭐⭐ **未做任何安全評估**——**其列出的 DNS 重綁定防護、每 POST 令牌、CSP、路徑限制與模型哈希門均為其自述**，**不主張**其實際安全**；**⑦ ⭐⭐ **未核實**其演示所用 adsb.lol 資料的**ODbL 許可標註與再利用條件**是否符合該許可要求**（**未查閱 ODbL 原文，亦未核實 adsb.lol 的使用條款**）；**⑧ ⭐ **未核實**其「132 個北美機場、約 80 家運營人、約 180 種機型」等參考資料的來源與時效**；**⑨ ⭐ ⚠️ **未核實**其「never transmits anything」這一網路行為聲明**——**本次未做任何流量觀測**；**⑩ ⭐ ⚠️ **不主張**其與任何航空監管機構、機場或資料提供方存在認可、授權或背書關係**；**⑪ ⭐ ⚠️ **其 topic 含 `portfolio`****（**暗示作者將其定位為作品集項目**）；**不主張**其可用於任何真實的航空安全監視、運行決策或監管用途**；**⑫ ⭐ ★0、fork 0**，**不主張成熟度／正確性／已被採用**（**儘管其工程深度、安全自覺與文檔量在本會話收集的專案中位居前列**）；**⑬ 是否有中文材料未核實**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/monykiss/aero-audit` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；README 17,369 位元組經 `raw.githubusercontent.com` 實測逐字核對；三個關鍵檔案經 raw 探測確認存在；**未克隆、未運行、未啟動、未做安全評估、未讀源碼與文檔**。

**aero-audit** is **an end-to-end aviation surveillance auditing system** (repository `monykiss/aero-audit`), with **measured MIT licence (`LICENSE` measured 200 on main), ★0, 0 forks, Python as the primary language (self-described as requiring 3.12+), a 3,985 KB repository, created and last pushed 2026-09-10** (**all GitHub API measurements, inside the thaw window**); **ten topics measurably present**: **`ads-b`, `anomaly-detection`, `aviation`, `computer-vision`, `machine-learning`, `portfolio`, `python`, `risk-management`, `security` and `surveillance`**; **the README measures 17,369 bytes** and **describes version 0.4.0**; **key files measurably present**: **`LICENSE`, `CHANGELOG.md` and `docs/DEMO.md`**. **⚠️ One scope point must be stated at the outset**: **this is aviation surveillance security (ADS-B integrity and spoofing detection), not aviation insurance**; **it does not fill this site’s true-zero aviation-insurance gap** (**see note ① below**). It is the fourth of this round’s four takes on **separating "what I observed" from "what I therefore conclude"**, **and the only one that writes "how accurate am I actually" directly into its scoring formula**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the README**): **the positioning reads verbatim**: **"Aviation surveillance auditing, end to end. aero-audit follows real aircraft from public ADS-B feeds, checks every position report against physics, integrity and safety rules plus an anomaly model, measures its own detection accuracy with injected attacks, scores risk from the evidence, and shows all of it in a terminal-style local app whose every action and report is tamper-evident."**; **with the declaration verbatim**: **"It runs offline in one command, on any machine, and never transmits anything."**

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐⭐ Measuring itself with injected attacks and then feeding the measured precision into the score as weights is the entry’s most important point, and the most thorough case this session has seen of self-measurement being plumbed back into production judgement** — verbatim: **"Measures itself: `aero evaluate` perturbs real aircraft with eight attack scenarios and reports recall, time-to-detect and per-rule precision. Those numbers weight the risk score and the risk register; two scenarios are known gaps and are reported as such."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three points deserve separate note**: **① the precision figures are not for a paper but are inputs to the scoring formula** (**its package structure corroborates this verbatim**: `audit/` contains **`policy (precision-weighted score)`**); **② two scenarios cannot be caught at all, and rather than deleting them from the metric or glossing over them it explicitly lists them as known gaps**; **③ against this site’s recurring theme of writing boundaries on the face of the work, this is one of the strongest forms — earlier rounds were mostly textual declarations, whereas here the uncatchable is inside the metric report itself** (**readable with round 331’s [[aida-tix-anomaly-detection]] and its reconciliation placeholders, and round 332’s [[insurance-fraud-risk-scoring]] and its PR-AUC of 1.00 as a bug report**; **⚠️ the entry does not claim its eight scenarios are sufficient or that the two gaps have been quantified — `aero evaluate` was not run**). **② ⭐⭐⭐ The "Trustworthy by construction — two things a reviewer can check rather than take on faith" section is the entry’s most notable verifiability point** — ⭐⭐ **that phrasing — letting a reviewer check for themselves rather than take it on faith — is this round’s theme stated directly**. **Its first item, "Auditable", reads verbatim**: **"The app’s audit log is a hash chain: every entry carries the SHA-256 of the one before it and of itself, so an edited, deleted or reordered line is named by `aero log verify` and by the CHAIN VERIFIED badge on the Audit log page. Every report ships with a provenance block (tool version, git commit, input recording and its hash, model hash and registry status, evaluation hash, threshold overrides) and a manifest that `aero log verify-report` … re-hash. Injected demo traffic is flagged in every finding."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Three points deserve separate note**: **① the hash chain does not merely resist tampering but names which line was edited, deleted or reordered**; **② every report carries a seven-field provenance block**; **③ injected demo traffic is flagged in every finding, so synthetic and real data are distinguishable at the output layer** (**readable with round 330’s [[catrisk-sim]] and round 332’s [[guidewire-claim-intelligence]] — all three authors refuse to let synthetic data pass as real results**). **③ ⭐⭐⭐ Its "Secure by default" section reads verbatim and is the most concrete treatment of local-service security this session has seen** — verbatim: **"A server on 127.0.0.1 is reachable from every web page you have open, so the app validates the `Host` header against DNS rebinding, requires a per-process token on every POST (which forces the CORS preflight the server never grants), checks `Origin` and `Sec-Fetch-Site`, serves a strict Content-Security-Policy with no inline script, confines every path parameter to the project’s data directories, accepts only `http(s)` webhooks, and loads a model only when its SHA-256 matches the registry that `aero train` wrote. Binding beyond loopback requires a token on every API call."** ⭐⭐⭐ **The premise worth remembering is that a localhost server is reachable from every web page you have open**; **and "a model is loaded only when its SHA-256 matches the registry written at training time" is a model-integrity gate students can borrow directly** (**⚠️ no security assessment was performed, so the entry does not claim the protections are complete**). **④ ⭐⭐ Its supply-chain and CI arrangements read verbatim and are concrete**: **"Dependencies install with `--require-hashes` from a universal lock; CI runs ruff, pytest, docs-drift, `pip-audit`, gitleaks over the full history, CodeQL and a container smoke test, with every action pinned to a commit SHA."** ⭐⭐ **Two things are unusual**: **`--require-hashes` from a universal lock (locking content rather than just versions)**, **and a `docs-drift` check — verifying that documentation has not drifted from the implementation** (**readable with round 329’s [[reinsurance-treaty-agent]] and its pre-commit hook that regenerates the workflow diagram — both fight documentation drift**). **⑤ ⭐⭐⭐ The division between rules and model reads verbatim and lands this round’s theme inside its architecture** — verbatim: **"Audits every fix with explainable rules: impossible jumps, speed and altitude physics, integrity below 14 CFR 91.227 minimums, replayed fixes, ghosts, emergency and hijack codes with confirmation tiers, holding, level busts, coverage gaps, stream floods and collapses, cross-feed disagreement, watchlists. Every finding maps to a control reference and a response playbook."**, **with the machine learning reading verbatim**: **"Learns the airspace’s normal envelope with per-regime IsolationForests over twelve kinematic features, percentile-calibrated, with two-fix persistence before a finding is raised."** ⭐⭐⭐ **Two points deserve separate note**: **① "every finding maps to a control reference and a response playbook" explicitly links what was found to what should therefore be done — precisely this round’s theme**;
